What my clients say

( FAQ )

Good questions, straight answers

What does a Fractional CMO actually do?+

I act as your part-time Chief Marketing Officer: setting strategy, owning the budget, managing your team and agencies, and reporting on revenue impact, typically for 1–3 days per week.

Who do you work best with?+

B2B companies and e-commerce brands between 500K and 30M in revenue that want to scale marketing profitably but don't need (or can't yet afford) a full-time CMO.

How fast can I expect results?+

Quick wins usually appear within the first 30 days (waste eliminated, tracking fixed). Compounding growth typically shows in months 2–4.

How do you charge?+

Monthly retainers for fractional CMO work, fixed fees for audits and workshops. Every engagement starts with a free strategy session so we can confirm fit.
